newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan's Lever Bros soars 6.53 percent.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan's Lever Bros soars 6.53 percent.

text.p: Lever Brothers Pakistan Ltd 50-rupee stock soared 46 rupees, or 6.53 percent, to 750 on foreign investor buying, dealers said.
Some 25,100 shares changed hands in early trade at the Karachi Stock Exchange due to foreign buying of the blue chip stock, dealer Shaukat Husain said.
The company manufactures edible oils, soaps and a large number of consumer products supplying demand in Pakistan and abroad,
The company paid 100 percent cash dividend for the 18 months ended December. -- Ibrahim Khan 9221-5685192.
